description: This file is the MainActivity for an Android MIDI synthesizer app, responsible for initializing MIDI, handling UI actions, and managing MIDI device connections.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for the MIDI synthesizer Android app, managing MIDI connection setup and UI interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, configures action bar, and triggers MIDI setup if supported.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu and maintains 'keep screen on' setting.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, toggling 'keep screen on' setting.

methods.name: setKeepScreenOn
methods.description: Enables or disables the 'keep screen on' flag for the activity window.

methods.name: setupMidi
methods.description: Initializes MIDI manager, finds MIDI device, and sets up connection selector.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources when activity is destroyed.
